daily.title: NFL QB in hospital at 4am before London game due to blood clots
daily.summary: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has blood clots in his lungs and, according to media reports, the former Super Bowl MVP is expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season.

daily.title: New video of Sydney Town Hall protest shows excessive force, court told
daily.summary: In the video clips, police can be seen grabbing protesters by the head or neck at a rally against the Israeli president in Sydney.

daily.title: Japan launches first mission to collect samples from Martian moon
daily.summary: An international space mission aiming to collect sand and rock from one of Mars's moons is expected to land in Australia once the sample is retrieved.

daily.title: Quick hits: Renshaw floored by miracle grab as Bavuma's six stops traffic
daily.summary: Matt Renshaw cannot believe his own fielding brilliance and Temba Bavuma's soaring six stops traffic after a soggy outfield threatens to ruin it all. Here are the quick hits from day two of the second Test between Australia and South Africa.

daily.title: Efforts to rehabilitate land damaged by Roe 8 works exceeding expectations
daily.summary: Almost a decade after parts of sensitive WA bushland were razed for a controversial Roe Highway extension that was never completed, efforts to restore the area have exceeded expectations.

daily.title: FIFA given deadline to answer questions over failed World Cup sell-off
daily.summary: UEFA gives FIFA until November 2 to release documents relating to Gianni Infantino's aborted attempts at a secretive investment plan for the World Cup and other governance issues.

daily.title: Behaviour expert says smart glasses bans at pools may be ineffective
daily.summary: One fifth of Victoria's councils have confirmed they are investigating or implementing measures to prohibit covert recording devices from community pools and recreation facilities over privacy concerns.

daily.title: Live: NAB to axe up to 2,500 job by mid-next year
daily.summary: NAB plans to slash about 6pc of its workforce. On Wall Street, Nasdaq leaps +1% as Wall Street fights "tech bubble" chat. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: Five NT community pools have closed and report warns there are more to come
daily.summary: Despite having the highest drowning rate per capita in Australia, more pools in the Northern Territory are in danger of being closed due to aging infrastructure and workforce shortages.

daily.title: Toll of war in Ukraine cited as Svitolina, Monfils announce end of marriage
daily.summary: World number six Elina Svitolina says she and former tennis player Gael Monfils are ending their marriage, with the Ukrainian adding that the emotional toll of Russia's war in her homeland has left her needing to rediscover herself.

daily.title: 'Crown jewels' of Australia's savannah tropics to become national parks
daily.summary: Tiny grasswrens, palm cockatoos and hundreds of wetlands will be protected under a major Queensland land deal involving three cattle stations turned national parks.

daily.title: Driver killed, bus and car engulfed in flames on Phillip Island
daily.summary: Police say the car crossed onto the wrong side of the road and struck the bus, which had 25 people on board.

daily.title: One man down and on a flattening pitch, Boland and Starc continue to shine
daily.summary: There were some moments of joy for South Africa as they tried to rescue the first innings. But Scott Boland and Mitchell Starc made sure Australia remained on top in the second Test.

daily.title: 'One election at a time': ACT Labor marks 25 years in power
daily.summary: Labor has been in office in the ACT for 25 years, and while it's not always been smooth sailing, the party's grip on power has been particularly tested in the past 12 months.

daily.title: LNP says 'a long way to go to reverse' Queensland's youth crime crisis
daily.summary: Despite data showing the number of victims of crime falling around 4 per cent, many Queenslanders say they still don't feel safe.

daily.title: I Am Australian co-writer 'not happy' song used at conservative conference
daily.summary: Musician Dobe Newton is "not happy, Jan" after the classic he co-wrote, I Am Australian, was used without permission at a conservative political conference.

daily.title: KI ferries close temporarily as ramps upgraded for new vessels
daily.summary: Ferry services to Kangaroo Island have temporarily stopped for three days as SeaLink prepares to introduce the first of two new vessels, after a "frustrating" wait for locals.

daily.title: Athletes out for gold at 'really important' Special Olympics Australia
daily.summary: Competitor Charlotte Bailey says the Games, which are underway in Melbourne, offer an important opportunity for people to see what the disabled community can do.

daily.title: What we know about China's new joint training facility in Laos
daily.summary: China says a newly built airport in Laos will be used to train pilots for Laos's air force. However, observers have questioned whether it will have a greater strategic purpose.

daily.title: 'Extremely fortunate' conditions bring caper white butterflies to Adelaide
daily.summary: Thousands of tiny white and black-tipped butterflies have swarmed south to Adelaide to avoid searing temperatures in Central Australia.

daily.title: Former coalmine site at centre of $12 billion plan to build trains
daily.summary: The development is expected to support up to 780 jobs during construction and about 550 ongoing jobs across the facility and supply chains, the NSW government says.

daily.title: Ethical practices in Australian fashion industry stalling, report finds
daily.summary: The Baptist World Aid Ethical Fashion Report finds there has been minimal improvement in sustainability and ethical practice in the industry.

daily.title: Alleged investment scam leaves Australians missing millions
daily.summary: The ABC has traced an alleged ghost investment scheme across the globe and found its enigmatic CEO may have links to terrorism.

daily.title: Ranger faces harassment after illegal mountain bike tracks shut down
daily.summary: Half a dozen unauthorised mountain bike tracks have been closed across Kunanyi/Mount Wellington this year. It has led a small group of riders to use popular walking tracks as an alternative.

daily.title: Could Labor's trust tax be as much as 60 per cent? Yes, but there's a reason
daily.summary: Labor's proposed trust tax could result in tax rates of 60 per cent in some circumstances as part of a crackdown on so-called "bucket companies" the government says are used to reduce tax.
